deviations.description: plan-format.md's Phase 1 'Consumers of this field' text (drafted from the dispatch's own framing) claimed skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md independently carries the 'Files to modify' heading-name dependency via its own H1 territory block. Live verification during Phase 6 found SKILL.md now has ZERO 'Files to modify' or 'territory' occurrences of its own -- it has been refactored (pre-existing, unrelated to this task -- git log shows the last touches to orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh were tasks 260/259/252/266, none of them this task) to fully delegate territory/dispatch-file composition to scripts/orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh, which DOES still carry the string.
deviations.reason: Corrected plan-format.md's 'Consumers of this field' subsection from four consumers (three heading-name-only) to three consumers (two heading-name-only), reflecting that SKILL.md and orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh are now one consumer, not two. This is a documentation-accuracy fix, not a functional change: the acceptance criterion (heading string unbroken, zero commits from this task touching any of the three named files) is satisfied either way -- git log confirms this task made zero edits to general-implementation-agent.md, skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md, or orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh.
